_about: EVA toolbox curation. Keys are calls as listed in the toolbox (plugin: namespace.Function, vs-jetpack: module.function). hide = left out of the toolbox, with the reason. defaults = values used when the field is left empty (vs-jetpack values are Python, plugin values as typed in the form). needs = settings without a default that must be filled in, with a hint. adapt = input format the function needs (the block converts to it and back); the compatibility scan also finds these by itself. notes = shown in the block. Edit freely; the toolbox reads it every time it opens. prep = a step run before the function: scene_detect marks scene changes (vs-jetpack sc_detect) for filters that need them. Clip settings: @group = the picture as it entered the filter group, @prev = before the previous filter, @self = this filter's own input (vs-jetpack: group / prev / current). @w / @h = picture size (vs-jetpack: w / h), @std = ntsc or pal. MVTools' super / vectors / data are made automatically.

notes.zsmooth.TTempSmooth: scthresh 0 = no scene-change detection (that needs the miscfilters plugin); the app's Steady chain uses it the same way.
notes.vsdeinterlace.vinverse: Before IVTC (on the telecined / interlaced frames) or on frames with leftover combing.
notes.zsmooth.Cnr4: Scene changes are marked first (vs-jetpack sc_detect), so nothing is blended across a cut.
notes.vsmasktools.stabilize_mask: Scene changes are marked first (vs-jetpack sc_detect).
notes.std.MaskedMerge: clipb = the picture before the group, mask = its edges (Sobel) unless you give one: the filters above stay off the lines.
notes.std.Merge: Mixes the result with the picture before the group (weight 0.5 = half each).
notes.vszip.LimitFilter: Limits how far the filters above may change the picture before the group (src).
notes.vsrgtools.contrasharpening: Gives back the sharpness the filters above took (src = the picture before the group).
notes.zsmooth.Repair: Repairs the result against the picture before the group (repairclip).
notes.bm3d.VFinal: Follow it with bm3d.VAggregate (same radius). ref is made by VBasic automatically.
notes.awarp.AWarp: The edge mask (ASobel + ABlur) is made automatically.
notes.vszip.AdaptiveBinarize: clip2 (the local average) is made automatically - a box blur.
notes.std.SelectEvery: cycle 5 / offsets 0,1,2,3 keeps 4 of every 5 frames (29.97 -> 23.976).
notes.descale.Debicubic: width / height = the resolution the picture was made at (DVDs: usually their own size - set it lower only for an upscaled source).
notes.vsdeinterlace.jivtc: Before IVTC, on the 29.97 telecined frames: put the group above Telecine (or use it for your own IVTC).
